delete_account.lead: You can delete your Archangel OS account and all personal data at any time — in the app (immediate) or by submitting a request on this page.
delete_account.in_app_steps: Sign in → Profile → scroll down → DELETE ACCOUNT & ALL DATA → confirm. Your account and data are erased right away.
delete_account.request_text: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We erase the account and its data within {days} days. No confirmation of the account's existence is sent to protect your privacy.
delete_account.done: Request received. The account and all personal data linked to this e-mail will be erased within {days} days.
delete_account.timeline: Retention period: personal data is erased within {days} days of the request; audit hashes are kept for the statutory period only.
wallet_link.title: CONNECT YOUR WALLET
wallet_link.hint: 1. Open your wallet and copy your Base address  2. Come back and tap PASTE.
wallet_link.no_address: No wallet address (0x…) found in the clipboard.
wallet_link.pasted: Address pasted — check it and tap LINK WALLET.
